caption:
True or False? 🤔

"Carrying a small balance helps your score."

The answer: false. Paying in full on time gets you the same benefit without paying interest.

Where did you first hear this one?
first_comment: Who told you this myth? Parents, friends, a bank? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Where did you hear this myth? @creditscoretruths

card.headline: Carrying a balance helps your score. True or false?
card.sub: False. Pay in full and skip the interest.
